name: Desk Terminal, Patched
tagline: One cased terminal patched into the family's desk: a lit lead runs from Next up into Coming up's rail, Home asks the family to give Vera something to plan, and every list hangs from a rail whose stops are its controls.
concept: Joined's cased terminal still stands at the left of every page. It is now thinner (a 6px case with a 2px graphite bezel) and wired into the desk: a lit lead leaves a socket on the case at Next up's row and lands in the NOW lamp of Coming up's steel rail, so the machine and the desk read as one drawing. Every list hangs from a rail whose stops are its controls, and each tube draws its own page's data: a countdown dial on Plans with the day of each plan at its lit tick, a numbered map on Ideas, late bars on To do and a needle on Status. The feeling is a calm desk, with the green-screen light kept for the places where the machine speaks.
companions:
- Bone (#d4cfc4): the family's words, the dates, and the 2px cap (40% alpha) over each band.
- Steel (#58697a line, #6b8396 reverse, #9cc4dc cap): rails, ring stops, 'here', latched keys, and now Status's dashed ghost needle and its key.
- Pewter (#7a8590): off and unset rings, and undated ticks.
- Sage (#86d9a6): the steady hover edge and the ticked box.
- Amber: only for late and 'needs a look', as words, ring stops and a 2px bar.
- Denim (#9db6d6): links only. To do's 'Edit or snooze' is a dimmed denim at rest and full denim when its row is hovered or focused.
- Graphite is the machine and slate is the desk. A warmer slate, now #172027, marks the month's weekends.
- Each kind's colour sits only in the ring round its icon.
- There is no cobalt wash (washGlow is 0).
decisions: Kept the line's law: one cased, lit terminal at the left of every page holds the tube, the deck of latched keys and the status foot, and a square, matte slate desk holds only the family's rows.
Budget: build.py strips every comment. The cobalt wash, the row afterglow transitions, the Plans ASCII trace and Home's band rings are gone. With this revision the sheet is 179.6k of 200k.

The case: 6px radius, a 2px #2c3135 bezel and an inset #ffffff0f lip, with no outer glow. The glass keeps E12-E17 and E20 at full strength. It is sticky on inner pages with no inner scroll. On Home it is static (see revisions).

Home's glass, top to bottom: her screen and 'VERA · FRI 2 OCT' on one fixed-height line; Next up in inverse beside a 5.5rem radar; '› 3 more after Next up' (the data has 4 plans, so '3' is the honest count); her last line, if there is one; a dashed rule. Then the h1 'Give Vera something to plan.' in Plex Sans Condensed 600 #a9eec0 with a bloom. Only 'plan' is white-hot, followed by the only blinking cursor on Home. Last comes the #06100b box behind a lit '›' prompt, in which the family types in Plex Sans ink.

Deck: FROM, the mic and Send sit straight under the field, then 'Send where I am'. The three ways to start are two-line keys ('usually Plans / To do / Ideas'). The long weekend starter spans both columns.

Home's desk: Coming up (the patch lead, with Next up as its lit first stop and rows set on the digit), then the one-strip setup band, then the To do tick line. Under them, on the same tracks as the bench: the kids' wishes under the terminal and Lately added under the desk.

Four signals everywhere: on is a lit lamp, waiting a steel dot, off a pewter ring, needs a look a 2px amber bar. Red is kept for something that has stopped. Status and Settings show a one-line legend.

Plans: Lit Manual's countdown dial in this line's case. It has 28 ticks with now at the top and the next plan's stretch of rim lit, swept by E17. Each lit tick now carries its day numeral in VT323, upright, so the dial maps onto the month beside it. Month names never break inside a word.
Ideas: a map of blips at their bearing and drive time, each an <a> to its row, numbered to the list. The drive column is now in sans tabular figures, and the leader runs right up to each figure.
Chat: the terminal holds the conversations and the Ready foot. On a phone it becomes one row above the thread: Family, Maya and Theo as keys, with the Ready lamp at the right.
title: *Give Vera something to plan.* (lit word: plan). It says FamilyDB's job outright: the family hands Vera a plan, an idea, a reminder or a calendar question, and the box under it is where they do that. It has no apostrophe for VT323 to break, and it doubles as the textarea's label.
measures: The final full render of palettes/x14a-desk-cross.json fails no hard checks. ink_on_bg is 12.49 and brand_on_bg 15.18 (the signature #6dff9c on #0b0e0c). Home: green share of colour 85.9%, bright-green 4.6 permille, hue entropy 0.386. Ideas: 57.9% green, entropy 0.382. Chat: 66.2%, 0.392. Status: 52.9%, 0.439. Home has 0 targets under 44px on desktop and on the phone, no sideways scroll on any page, and its smallest text is 12px (the legal line). Colour distances: kinds 13.6 / deutan 5.5 / protan 7.4, sections 13.6 / 5.5 / 6.1. One guideline is missed: the page's words differ from today's, worst on Plans at 43%, because of the dial's words, the Ideas map and the head-row ledes. removed.txt is empty. The sheet is 179,599 characters.
strengths: The patch lead is still the signature. On Home the case now holds still with the desk and the scrollback row has a fixed height, so the socket always sits on Next up's row and the lead always lands in the NOW lamp.
Home has one vertical grid. The lower bands sit on the bench's own 30rem + 2rem tracks: the kids' wishes under the terminal, Lately added under the desk.
The headline names the job, and the light sits where attention belongs: a white-hot 'plan', one blinking cursor, a lit prompt, and the glass's own halo, bloom and scanlines.
One mechanism carries every list: rails whose ring stops are the controls (Coming up, setup's three stops, To do's ticks), with a sans due margin and a lit NOW run between late and upcoming.

Each tube draws its page's data. The Plans dial now numbers its lit days against the month grid. Status's needle floats over a scale plate with a dashed steel ghost that pokes past it, so a $0.00 day still reads as a measurement.
The figures are typeset as one system: Plex Sans tabular for counts, drive times and dues; Plex Mono only for clock times and ids; leaders that run right up to their figures.
weaknesses: The three downtown blips on the Ideas map (6, 8, 10) still have overlapping 44px hit circles. I declined the shared stacked label (see revisions), so a click between the dots picks whichever is drawn last.
On a 390px phone, 'Send where I am' still wraps to its own row under FROM, the mic and Send. The five controls cannot share 328px at 44px targets. The row gap was tightened instead.
The folded Ready lip on Settings and the form is lighter now, but it is still a second header over the desk. A judge may prefer it moved into the head row.
The kids' wishes band under the terminal is short (two rows at '0 open'), so the lower left ends about 130px above Lately added.
On Plans, the sweep wedge crosses the lit tick for day 4 in the still, so that one tick can still look slightly off its radial in a screenshot.
On a phone the Chat lede is hidden, so those words are gone from that view.
revisions: Home's grid: on wide screens .page-home .lower is now 30rem minmax(0,1fr) with a 2rem gap. The kids' wishes come first in the DOM, under the terminal, and Lately added sits under the desk (it spans both tracks when it is alone). Head and row figures drop the slashed-zero feature, so '0 open' is in Plex Sans tabular like every other figure.

Home's lead: on Home the terminal is no longer sticky (position:relative, no max-height), so it scrolls with the desk and the socket stays on the case. The scrollback row is one 1.5rem nowrap line. Her last line moved below the Next up block, so it can never push Next up off the socket.

To do page: the row and column heads are now 8.5rem 2.75rem minmax(0,1fr) 6rem 7rem, and the title wraps (white-space normal, text-wrap pretty, no ellipsis). 'Book the campsite at Silver Falls' now shows in full. 'Edit or snooze' rests as a dimmed denim with a faint underline and turns full denim on row hover or focus-within.

Ideas figures: the drive is in Plex Sans 500 tabular in a fixed column. On a row with a drive, the row's leader is hidden and the drive cell spans the leader track, drawing its own dotted fill, so every leader ends at its figure. The compass word is in sans as well. The For column narrowed to 6.5rem so no titles are cut. On phones, as before, there are no leaders.

Folded terminal (Settings, the form): the slab is now a lip, with a 2px bezel top and left edge, a 6px corner and the case colour fading into the desk, pulled down onto the desk at the desk's width. The breadcrumb is now a 0.8125rem kicker over the title, on the title's left edge, with a faint slash.

Plans dial: each lit tick carries its plan's day numeral (4, 9, 17, 24) in VT323 at about 14.5px, counter-rotated to stand upright inside the ring. The weekend columns are raised to #172027, which samples as (23,32,39) in the shot.

Status meter: both needles now start from a faint inner scale-plate arc instead of the tube's lower bezel, so the base is lifted. The ghost needle is dashed steel #6b8396 with a #9cc4dc cap, longer than the hot needle, so it shows past the scale even at $0.00. The '0' sits outside the arc's start. The readout's 'Average day' key is now a matching dashed steel swatch.

Phones: the Chat terminal is one row above the thread (the conversation keys, then the Ready lamp at the right), with the desk-first DOM swap removed, so the drawing and the DOM agree. Inner-page ledes are 0.9375rem on phones, and Chat's is hidden there. The ledge's wrap gap on Home is tightened to 0.

Declined: the shared stacked label with one <a> per number for the 6/8/10 cluster on the Ideas map. In a map about 200px across, three per-number links would be three targets under 44px, and this line has always shipped with none. Each dot still links to its own row, the numbers match the list one line away, and keyboard order is the list's.

Declined, in part: putting 'Send where I am' inline after Send on a 390px phone. FROM, the select, the mic, Send and the checkbox need about 390px at 44px targets, against 328px available, so it wraps, now with no extra gap.
crit: Home, the lower grid breaks the sight lines. Lately added runs 32-742px and The kids' wishes 774-1248px. That is a second column split that matches neither the bench (terminal 32-512, desk 544-1248) nor anything else, so Home has two unrelated vertical grids. Put the lower bands on the bench's own track: either both inside the desk column under To do, or a full-width row whose split falls on the 30rem + gutter line, e.g. `.page-home .lower{grid-template-columns:30rem minmax(0,1fr);gap:2rem}`. Then Lately added's left edge sits under the terminal and the wishes' edge under the desk. While there, the kids' wishes '0 open' is set in slashed-zero mono. Set it in Plex Sans tabular like every other head figure ('4 coming', '12 ideas').

Home, the lead is fragile. The case is sticky (`.bench > .terminal{position:sticky}`), but the lead and socket are drawn by `.page-home .coming::before/::after` at a fixed `--lead-y:4.5rem`. As soon as the desk scrolls under the held case, the socket slides off the machine and the lead points at nothing. On Home the terminal is shorter than the desk, so make it hold still with the desk: `.page-home .bench > .terminal{position:static}` (or `align-self:start` without sticky). Pin `--lead-y` to the NEXT UP row by giving the scrollback row a fixed block-size (one line, `white-space:nowrap`), so a longer tube-said line cannot move Next up off the socket.

To do page, the name column truncates with room to spare. 'Book the campsite at Silver …' is cut while 'Edit or snooze' and 'Who' hold fixed widths. Make the row grid `grid-template-columns:8.5rem 2.75rem minmax(0,1fr) auto auto` with the title allowed to wrap to two lines (`text-overflow:clip; white-space:normal; text-wrap:pretty`), and give 'Edit or snooze' a dim denim at rest, with the full link colour only on row hover/focus, so five identical links do not form a column louder than the tasks.

Ideas page, the figures. The Drive column ('2 h 10 min', '27 min') is letterspaced mono, against this cross's own rule of sans tabular figures in due margins. The dotted leaders after the kind word stop well short of short figures ('27 min' sits 50px from its leader's end). Set `.ideas-list .drive` in Plex Sans 500 `font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums`, right-aligned in a fixed 6.5rem column, so every leader runs to its figure. On the map, the '6 8 10' downtown cluster's 44px hit circles overlap: give the cluster one shared leader to a stacked label and one `<a>` per number in that label, rather than three overlapping blip targets.

Folded terminal on Settings and the form: the 'Ready · OpenAI · gpt-6-luna · $2.00 a day' strip sits as a fully boxed graphite slab between the head row and the desk. It is the heaviest box on the page, and it stops at 1024px while the head row runs to 1248. Either carry the case's 2px bezel only as a top-and-left lip (`border-width:2px 0 0 2px`) at the desk's width, or move the folded Ready line into the head row at the right, where an inner page's primary sits. On the form, also fix the breadcrumb: 'Ideas /' floats small on a different baseline from 'New idea'. Align it to the h1's baseline (`align-items:last baseline`) or raise it to sit over the title as a 0.8125rem kicker.

Plans: the dial's lit ticks for days with plans read as stray marks. The lit tick near one o'clock is drawn at a different angle from its neighbours, and the ticks for past plans (29 Sep, 1 Oct) should not appear on a forward 28-day countdown. Rotate every `.dial-tick.on` on the same radial as its ring tick, show only now to now + 28 days, and add the plan's day numeral in VT323 ≥14px just outside each lit tick, so the dial maps to the month grid beside it. The weekend slate #141b20 does not register in the month shot. Raise it to about #172027 for `.month td:nth-child(n+6)` so the warmer step can be seen.

Status, the needle meter at $0.00: the hot needle lies on the 0 stop, and the ghost needle at the 30-day average ($0.04) sits on top of it, so neither shows and the '0' label collides with the needle's foot. Draw the ghost as a dashed steel needle (#6b8396) with its label at the arc's outer edge. Move the '0' scale label outside the arc's start. Lift the empty arc's left end so the needle base is not clipped at the tube's lower bezel.

Phone. On Chat the head lede takes three 1.0625rem lines before the thread, and the folded Conversations terminal cannot be seen above the sticky box. Clamp the inner-page lede to one line on narrow screens (`.page-head .lede{display:none}` under 30rem, or a smaller 0.9375rem step). Put the Ready foot and the conversation switcher as one row above the thread, so a kid can change conversations without scrolling past the whole log. On Home's phone, the brief allows 'Send where I am' to wrap, but it now takes its own 3rem row. Put it inline after Send at the row's end where the 390px width allows (`flex-wrap:wrap` with the checkbox `margin-left:auto`).

name: Quote Board, Posted
tagline: An evening count board: every section led by one figure on its label's line, slate trays and bone ink, with the phosphor lit only where something is live.
concept: This is Quote Board at Evening with the costume taken off. Every page, the new-idea form included, opens on one condensed title, its figure and a stacked legend. Three of the tour's glance devices (contents-line heads with a dotted leader, hop rows with large day numerals, setup rings) are rebuilt as the board's own parts, and Status's lamp banks now use the same contents line. The feel is a calm evening trading desk: each hue has one job, the one live number on a page glows with the tube's layered halo, Vera's newest line lands lit, and everything else is matte slate and bone.
companions: Steel (#6b8396 reverse, #9cc4dc cap) marks "here": the current key, latched filter keys, the current tab and today in the month. It always carries a 6px phosphor lamp at the top right, and a steel ring is the system's "off / none set". Denim (#9db6d6) is links. Wheat (#d6c290) is To do: its figure, its cell's cap and the activity kind. Clay (#cf9a7c) is people (Family, Memory, You) and the restaurant kind. Heather (#bba6e0) is Ideas, the event kind, the Links bank count and the form's +1. Steel-cyan (#88d2e4) is Plans: the month word in hop rows, the trip kinds and the Keys bank count. Rose (#eba6c8) is Wishes and shows. Coral (#ff7a5c, moved from #ff7f66 this revision) is the seasonal kind only. Amber (#ffb850) means late, needs a look and setup, and nothing else. Bone ink sits on slate trays (#151b1e / #10161a), and green-black glass (#111712) holds Vera's lines.
decisions: Started from r13-mut-3's palette and variant folder. Every change is a token, or a layer appended at the foot of its own sheet ('POSTED', then 'REVISION 2'), so the parent's system stays readable and each fix can be traced.

Costume removed: no visible digit keycaps and no 0 gear, but every accesskey stays in the markup. The footer's Alt legend became a <details class=keys-help> called 'Keyboard' that opens a slate card of keys and modifiers.
The current key keeps the steel reverse cell and gains a 6px lit lamp (L140). The same lamp marks latched filter keys and the current tab, so 'here' is one sign across the app.

Colour, one job per hue: To do wheat, people clay, Ideas heather, Plans steel-cyan, amber caution only. Seasons moved to coral #ff7a5c so that every kind and section pair clears dE 12 for typical sight and 5 under protan and deutan simulation.

Quote head standard: condensed Archivo at clamp(2.5..4rem)/0.95. A grid legend with space-between puts the unit at about the figure's cap height and the change line on its baseline. The change line's 7px lamp is lit (live), an amber ring (late or needs a look) or a steel ring.

Rule 'one live figure per page': Status's '6 working' and Chat's reply count are in #6dff9c with E1's halo, a hot core and (this revision) a fourth wide layer at the greeting word's strength. Every other figure is matte in its section ink and plays the line's arrival flash. Reduced motion stops the flash, and more-contrast removes the halo.

Home title 'Give Vera something / to *plan*.', with only 'plan' lit and the full stop in bone. The break before 'to' now holds on the phone too. The box rests in a faint halo and turns a full phosphor edge with E4 bloom while someone writes.
Setup is Sill Line's three-ring strip in the quote idiom: an amber lamp, the figure 3, numbered 44px rings joined by a steel line, and 'Next: choose your own password' on the right.

Board heads are Waypoint's readout through count_head (sentence-case label, dotted leader, figure on the same baseline in section ink). Coming up uses hop rows. This revision starts the cell after the plan the Next up tube shows ('Coming up ... 3 more'), matching the tube's '3 more on the radar'. All three cells stretch to one height with their feet on one line.

Status: each of the three banks is now a contents line ('Answers ..... 3 of 4' in phosphor with E1, Keys steel-cyan, Links heather, at 2.5rem condensed). The lamps sit under it and a shape legend (working / partly / off or none set) runs across the foot. The strip stretches to the spend tube's height, and the 30-day line sits below it. A missing key reads 'none set' in faint ink beside a steel ring.

Household row from Settled Light: Wishes, Memory, Family, Status and Settings as contents lines with 2px caps in section ink. Memory now shows a faint '—' on the shared baseline. The Status cell counts its own three lamps as 'of 3 lit', and its off lamps are 9px steel rings.

Ideas: at 64rem and wider the kinds are one row of latched keys with grey (--label) icons and faint tabular counts. Ink comes back only on the latched key and in the register's Kind column, and the Filter chip no longer repeats 'any kind' at that width.
To do: a latched key row (Open 4, Late 3 in amber, Done, Cancelled, All), every row condensed 600 at 1.125rem, late rows with amber due words and a 2px amber edge, and the NOW divider with its lamp.

Chat: body-size lines, green-black glass bubbles with a 30% phosphor edge, and the family on the right with initial keys. On a phone (40rem and below) her screen and the family's initials move into each line's head row at 1.5rem, so bubbles run nearly the full measure. Her newest line plays the 'arrived' flash on :last-child as well as :target.

Crumbs are sentence-case sans 0.8125rem in --label with a '‹', so mono caps appear only in legends and column heads. The new-idea form got an idea_form.html override and carries the quote device: 'New idea +1 / TO THE IDEAS / 11 KINDS TO PICK FROM' in heather.
title: Give Vera something to *plan*. The page's job is planning the family's time, and 'plan' is the word lit in phosphor. 'Something' takes in a reminder, an idea for someday or a wish as readily as a dated plan, and Vera's name comes from {{ assistant }}.
measures: Final full render: 0 hard checks failed and 1 guideline missed (page words differ, worst Plans at 48.1%, from the hop rows and quote legends). Seasons moved to #ff7a5c, so every CIEDE2000 pair now passes: kinds 14.0 typical, protan 6.7 (was 4.8), deutan 6.1; sections 14.6 / 5.5 / 6.1. ink_on_bg 12.49:1, brand_on_bg 15.18:1, brand is exactly #6dff9c. Green share of colour: Home 65.5%, Ideas 62.3%, Chat 71.9%, Status 62.4%. Hue entropy: Home .525, Ideas .424, Chat .303, Status .40. Bright-green permille: Home 4.6, Ideas 6.4, Chat 4.3, Status 1.3. Targets under 44px: 0 on every desktop page and on chat-phone, 1 on home-phone. No sideways scroll anywhere. Smallest text is 12px (11.7px on General's code line).
strengths: Every page, the form now included, opens on the same quote head, and the 7px change lamp (lit, amber ring, steel ring) says the state in shape as well as colour.
Hues each have one job. Amber appears only on late, setup and needs-a-look, and the phosphor only on live things, so the page reads calm and grounded with the light where attention belongs.
One contents-line device (label, dotted leader, figure on one baseline) now heads Home's cells, the household row and Status's lamp banks: a rule that would hold on any page.
Status now has colour and a real index: banks with large figures in their owners' inks, lamps beneath, a shape legend, and the strip as tall as the spend tube.
Home's board is level, its feet on one line, and it no longer repeats the plan on the Next up tube.
The phone is improved: six named tabs including 'Wishes', a deliberate title break, Next up cut to one line, and chat bubbles that run the measure with her mark inside the line.

The original light is back where the phosphor is: the lit word, the live figure at the greeting's strength, lamps that breathe, Vera's newest line landing lit, the tubes at full bloom, and the box that lights while someone writes.
weaknesses: Chat's legend reads 'REPLIES ON 27 SEP', not 'replies today'. The chat view gives the template no clock, so it cannot tell whether the newest reply was today; one line in chat.py would make it honest.

The new-idea form's figure is '+1' with a count of kinds to pick from, not the brief's 'No. 13', because the form view passes no idea count. It is a change figure rather than a count, so a judge may read it as ornament.
Home's Status cell ('1 of 3 lit') still counts different signals from the Status page ('6 working / 7 off'). It is now labelled as its own three lamps, but the two figures still differ.

With the first plan moved to the tube, Coming up lost its lit 'Next' numeral, so the board's cells have no phosphor of their own, and the cell has some empty tray above its foot when the plans are few.
The page's words differ a lot from today (up to 48% on Plans), mostly from the hop rows and quote legends, and the family's wording would follow.
Chat is still the most monochrome page (hue entropy .30, 72% green), because nearly everything coloured there is her glass and her light.
The legend's top line sits a few pixels under the figure's cap height rather than exactly on it, and the arrival flashes have nearly finished by the time the 1.8s still is taken.

Added a working / partly / off-or-none-set shape legend across the strip's foot. Give each bank its label, then its figure at 2.5rem condensed in the owner's ink (answers phosphor E1, keys steel-cyan, links heather) on the label's baseline with a dotted leader, the same contents line as the Home cells. Chat head (chat.html line 28, q_unit = 'replies ' ~ last_day): 'REPLIES 27 SEP' reads as a date, not a count, and the legend packs the dot and both lines into 30px. Set unit to 'replies today' when last_day is today, and 'replies, ' ~ last_day otherwise ('REPLIES, 27 SEP'). Give the legend the same align-content:space-between stretch as the other pages (in the shot its top line sits above the figure's cap height). name: Trued, Headlamp
tagline: The family's week as a signal box's lit track diagram, with the Next up tube standing at full height as the line's lit head, graphite plates, one lit strip for the month and a spend meter on the glass.
concept: Trued's line language stays as it was: a terminus at the start, ring stops, a T buffer at the end and one lamp at now. The Next up tube is now the line's lit head. It stands flush on Coming up's rail, its phosphor power wire drops onto its own stop, and the run is lit from the now lamp at its foot to the second stop. Rails appear only where there is an order: the month is a grid with one strip of glass above it, Ideas has a line from home at true drive distance, and Status opens on a moving-coil meter. It should feel like a calm signal box at night: graphite and slate, with one lamp lit where you are about to act.

It goes on the rails, the starter branch and its stops, the setup stub's rings, the Ideas stations and their leaders, the banks' hairline, links, and the 12% wash of the row afterglow. Graphite #15191a (chroma under 0.01) with a #2c3336 hairline is a plan's plate wherever one is drawn: Home's plates and the month's cells. The family's chat bubble is a close graphite, #1b2124. There is no navy and there are no caps. Cyan #74e6f0 is only for plan rings and the date chips' month. Kind rings keep their grounded hues. Amber means late or needs a look: the late words, the half lamps, and one 6px lamp beside 'Finish setting up'. Sage #86d9a6 is the afterglow's edge, so a row being pointed at never reads as live. #6dff9c is kept for the motif: the mark, Send, 'plan', the box while someone writes in it, the junction lamp, focus rings, the now lamps and the run each one lights (one per line or strip), the tube's power wire, the next setup stop, today's cell, home on the Ideas strip, the meter's needle, and every tube's glass. Plans on glass are dim phosphor rings, not lamps.
decisions: Title: 'Tell Vera what needs a *plan*.' at clamp(2.25rem, 4vw, 3rem), Archivo 700 at 88% width, with text-wrap: balance. Only 'plan' is lit, with E1 and a hot core, and the full stop sits in the title's own run. The box fills the board's height. On a phone the title is 2rem.

Coming up: the tube is 21.5rem wide at 4:3 and sits flush with the band's left edge. The now lamp stands at its left foot in the tube's own column, so the run leaves the lamp straight under the glass. A 2px power wire, 1.6rem long and E2-lit (a white core, then 6, 14 and 26px of phosphor), drops from the chin to its stop. The run is lit from now to Mount St. Helens and is steel after that, ending at a T buffer.

The head ('Coming up 4 coming · next Sun 4 Oct 13:00', the one-line Google note and 'All plans') stands beside the tube, above the plates. At 64rem and wider, the plates stretch from under the head down to the rail (the critic's option b), so the tube and the plates stand on the rail together with no dead slate band. The spare height goes to a 21px Archivo 700 name, set balanced, with who it is for and the time well pinned to the foot.

Plates are graphite #15191a with a #2c3336 hairline and no cap. The kind's colour lives only in its ring. A template macro (nb) uses no-break spaces to join 'St.', short abbreviations and initials to their neighbours. Home's plates and the month's cells both use it, so 'Mount St. Helens' never breaks.

Setup is section.setup-line: one 60px band on the slate tray. It holds a 6px amber lamp and 'Finish setting up', a steel stub of three numbered ring stops (step 1 lit #6dff9c), step 1's link at body size, 'then Telegram · Google Calendar' as words, a T buffer and 'All 3 steps →'. The stops are 1.35rem rather than 0.875rem, so that the numerals stay readable.

Plans month: the grid is a grid again. Today's cell has a 1px #6dff9c outline with E4 and 'now'. Each plan day has a cyan ring before its numeral, and titles are balanced. The glass strip above follows the line's own rule of one lamp: the now lamp breathes at today with 'now' set above it, and the run is lit to the next plan only, whose ring carries the run's light. Plans further on are 55% phosphor rings with no halo, and past plans are 26%. Numerals are 12.5px DM Mono on odd days, plus today and the plan days.

Ideas: the line from home has ring stops (steel on the glass) at their true drive time on a log scale, with mileposts at 15 min, 30 min, 1 h, 2 h and 3 h, so the day trips sit visibly far down the line. Each station's number (the row's No.) stands on a short leader and fans out where places crowd, so no two numbers collide. The numbers are dim phosphor. Only home, the run and the nearest stop are lit, and pointing at a row lights its station. The caption keeps the parent's words, with Nearest and Furthest as links, and the blinking block is gone.

Status (Desk Terminal's meter, redrawn): the arc uses a square-root scale, so the first eighth of the limit takes a third of the sweep. Labels in VT323 sit at 0, $0.25, $1.00 and $2.00, with a dashed hot tick at the limit and a dashed ghost needle on the 30-day average day, now well clear of zero. The needle is one 2px hot line with a soft two-step halo. It pivots on a hub cap inside the glass and kicks in when the tube warms. 'SPENT TODAY, ABOUT $0.00' sits in the top corner and the case's power lamp breathes. The lamp banks are centred under a steel hairline.

Row afterglow (Quote Board's, rebuilt): a 12% steel wash, a 2px sage inset edge and an 18px halo. It comes on in 0.12s and fades over 1.4s on :hover and :has(:focus-visible). It covers plates, To do, Ideas, Lately added, Settings rows, the month's plans and the starter keys, whose ring stop lights too. With reduced motion it is instant.

To do: the margin shows only the date, the figure then 'Oct' over 'Sun', in DM Mono at one size in --ink-3. An hour shows only when it falls on a quarter hour, so the seeded '19:56' is gone. Home and the To do page share the 1.25rem gutter.
Starters keep their quiet second line ('usually lands in Plans', 'in To do', 'in Ideas', 13px, --ink-3) on the phone too. 'Or start with' is a real label at the junction (DM Sans 600, 13px).
The bar has a Home key with the house icon, ahead of Vera. The family's chat bubbles are graphite #1b2124, so there is no navy anywhere on the page.

STYLE notes are written into headlamp.css's header, so the system holds on pages the sheets do not show: --plate graphite with its hairline, section.setup-line, one lamp per line or strip (every other stop a ring), the meter's square-root scale, and numerals on glass at 12px or more.

firstDraft.name: Waypoint, Ruled
firstDraft.concept: This is Waypoint Lamps with its execution faults cleared and the main camp's page structure taken in. It keeps the 1969 console's instrument: the four-week route with each plan's day numeral in its waypoint ring, the same numeral leading its row and ringed in its month cell, the readout strip, the radar Next up tube and the needle meter. Read-only lists now sit on the ground under engraved rule heads, and every page follows one visible shape law. It should feel like a calm, exact cockpit, lit only where something is live.
